preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 10
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(6 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line after T is an integer N (6 ≤ N ≤ 1000) representing the number of integers on the blackboard.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line, N in zip(stdin.splitlines()[2::2], [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains exactly N space-separated integers (0 ≤ A_i ≤ 10^9) representing the numbers on the blackboard.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines) == 2 * T for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()[i:i+2] for i in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), 2)])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output consists of exactly two lines: the first line is M (0 ≤ M ≤ 11111), and the next M lines are the operations.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(output_lines[0]) <= 11111 for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()[i:i+2] for i in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), 2)])
postconditions.description: For each test case, M is the number of operations (0 ≤ M ≤ 11111).

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines) == int(output_lines[0]) + 1 for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()[i:i+2] for i in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), 2)])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the number of operation lines matches M.

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= int(num) <= 10**9 for num in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1::2])
postconditions.description: Each operation line contains three integers A, B, and C (0 ≤ A, B, C ≤ 10^9) that are present on the blackboard at the time of the operation.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(num) in current_board for num in line.split()) for line, current_board in zip(stdout.splitlines()[1::2], [parse_board(stdin, test_case_idx) for test_case_idx in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: Each operation's A, B, and C must be present on the blackboard at the time of the operation, where the board evolves according to the operations.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(num) == 0 for num in parse_board(stdin, test_case_idx, operations)) for test_case_idx, operations in enumerate([stdout.splitlines()[i+1:i+1+int(stdout.splitlines()[i])] for i in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), 2)]))
postconditions.description: After performing all operations for each test case, all numbers on the blackboard are 0.
